data.summary: Seeking position to utilize my skills and ability in IT Infrastructure/ Data Center & Telecom Industry that offers security and professional growth while being resourceful, innovative, flexible & superior work ethics will add maximum value to the organization. Work for an organization that provides me with challenging opportunities and brings out the best in me.

technical_skills: Working experience under ITIL process with good experience in Managing Data Center Network for operation,
Experience in End-to-End IT Infrastructure management for Implementation, Operation, Maintenance & Capacity management,
Experience in 24/7 Datacenter operations & handling Core Network, Aggregation, Access & Management OOB layers.
Good knowledge in CISCO Network & Security, VMware virtualization [NSX, VCF, VCP] & EMC Storage Products.
Working Experience with Data center Nexus Switches, ISR Router, and ASR Routers, NCS 540,560 Routers, Cisco ASA Fire wall, F5 Load balancer, Cisco Fabrics & Cisco UCS etc.
Working Experience with Dell, HP, IBM & Cisco Rack & Blade Servers configuration & maintenance.
Experienced in Routing protocols like OSPF, ISIS & BGP ldp, Switching like STP RSTP & MSTP etc.
Advanced Data center technologies like Leaf/TOR, Spine, Border leaf, DC - DR replication etc.
Experience in ERPS, VRRP, GLBP, HSRP, VPC, Port channeling, bundling, port bonding NIC Teaming & Ether channeling etc.
Experience Cisco automation tools like ACI, Cisco CNAAP & NOC APS for config automation.
tools_and_platforms: Dell, HP, IBM & Cisco Rack & Blade Servers
domain_and_functional: Routing protocols like OSPF, ISIS & BGP ldp
Advanced Data center technologies like Leaf/TOR, Spine, Border leaf, DC - DR replication
analyzing root cause, identifying known errors or new errors & for code BUGS, coordinating actions to fix it
ERPS, VRRP, GLBP, HSRP, VPC, Port channeling, bundling, port bonding NIC Teaming & Ether channeling
Problem Trends and Planning and Driving Improvement Plan
Telecom Datacenter Operations, Expansion & Capacity Management
soft_skills: Excellent oral, written communication, interpersonal, logical & analytical skills.
Ability to deliver presentations and convey design and Product Trainings to multiple audiences along with preparing documentation like LLD, HLD & Configurations files etc.

Excellent Co-ordination skills to handle ISPs, Government officials, project (Business, Supplier, Process Development and Change Management) & resolve any conflicts that arise within the team, vendor, business team, Service Delivery team.
Ability to handle & manage field engineers, vendors & manpower management for project implementing, operations &make sure the Service Level Agreement are meet.
Mentoring new team members & training them in understanding the process & procedure

experience.role: Senior Network Engineer Data Center Infrastructure operation
responsibilities: Implementation, Integration & Support for Datacenters Products like Powerflex Rack & Appliance systems, VBLOCK, VxBlocks, VX Rails & VX Rack IR through Remote & onsite.
Handled & owned responsibility of Network Operation & Maintenance for client Capital Group customer datacenter Environment as a Senior Residence Engineer/ SPOC for more than 3 Years.

Implementing & supporting Datacenter Networking using Cisco products like IOS Routers, Switches, Nexus Family of Switches, and Cisco Unified Computing Systems & Cisco Virtual Switch Solution Nexus 1000v.
Performance Re-Build of VBlocks System as per the required changes & RCM Upgrade at customer Data centers.
Performing tests on the new products & providing necessary feedback before integration with existing system.
Reviewing and Validating Customer Requirements, providing suggestions on amendments required before implementing the configuration on VBLOCK/VxBlock & VX Rack IR Systems.
Reviewing the existing SOPs & suggesting changes based on the new product enhancement.
Mentoring new team members & training them in understanding the process & procedure for new VBLOCK/VxBlock & VX Rack IR Systems.
Providing Network support for VCE VBLOCK Data Center Network, UCS Compute Technical issues,
Supporting 24/7 Network Support operation across globe like US Customer, middle east, EMEA Europe & Asia customers for Incidents, Alerts, Faults & new services provisioning service requests.

Preparing & publishing daily, weekly, monthly & quarterly progress report & presentation & maintaining the SLA of each build also responsible for smooth shift handover, responding to global queries & managing trainings.
Coordinating with Major Vendor like CISCO, VMware & EMC for part replacement & TAC Support also engaging Escalation Engineer, Engineering Team & Customer Advocate coordination.
Supporting for D&I field team for new Implementation related issues for onsite Engineers.

Creating a SOP & KB article for issue fixed along with procedures getting it approved by management & making it available for all support engineer & Achieving 90% of CSAT & providing on call support in weekends.
technologies: Cisco products like IOS Routers, Switches, Nexus Family of Switches

experience.role: Data Center Network Lead, Data center Operation, Capacity Management & Implementation
responsibilities: End to Managing Telecom Datacenter Operations, Expansion & Capacity Management for Network.

Preparing Utilization report regularly & LLD & HLD changes, Understanding the reason for high utilization, Proposing & executing Port Bundling & Bandwidth augmentation, Adding New line cards & increasing ports availability.
Proposing & executing new Aggregation, Access & Core Router integration, Link Shifting & cleaning up of unused Interfaces
Resolving Tickets for DC & getting them closed within SLA, DC component’s up for 24/7, Handling ISIS, BGP & ERPS issues
Coordinating all stake holders CMPs, Backhaul, Fiber Planning Team for Fiber Readiness. & NH Teams.
Coordinating Transport Team [SDH & DWDM] for Transport Readiness & Resolving Compliance Issues & Security breaches.
Creating Change Request, Planed Events’ & Executing CR’s/PE’s by coordinating with CMPs, JC Backhaul & CAB Approvals.
Getting BGP & ISIS configuration, Creating MOPs/ SOPs, getting approval for the MOP from NPE NHQ for Guidelines
Validate Nodal Design Documents & Revise NDD as per the change or replacement in Infra.
Preparing configuration file available for field Engineers & Vendor for smooth Installation & commissioning with zero errors.
Working towards keeping all Core Link utilization under norms of 50 percent & augment regularly as one requirement.
Supporting NOKIA & CISCO Teams for smooth project executions for 5G Network implementation across Karnataka
Keeping updated with regular components upgraded to the latest Version based on Release matrix.

experience.role: IT Infrastructure, Data center Products Operation & Support
responsibilities: Implementation, Integration & Support for Datacenters Products like VCE VBLOCK, VxBlocks, VX Rails & VX Rack IR through Remote & onsite.
Handled & owned responsibility of Network Operation & Maintenance for client Capital Group customer datacenter Environment as a Senior Residence Engineer/ SPOC for more than 3 Years.

Implementing & supporting Datacenter Networking using Cisco products like IOS Routers, Switches, Nexus Family of Switches, and Cisco Unified Computing Systems & Cisco Virtual Switch Solution Nexus 1000v.
Performance Re-Build of VBlocks System as per the required changes & RCM Upgrade at customer Data centers.
Performing tests on the new products & providing necessary feedback before integration with existing system.
Reviewing and Validating Customer Requirements, providing suggestions on amendments required before implementing the configuration on VBLOCK/VxBlock & VX Rack IR Systems.

experience.role: Senior Network Engineer for Data Center Infrastructure Operations, Build & Expansion [UIDAI –AADHAR Govt of India
responsibilities: Responsible for providing 24/7 Infrastructure support under Network Operations & implementation for ensuring data center availability and reliability meet the requirements of data operations.
Assist in maintenance and monitoring of all Data Center systems to include incidents/events, problems & change management
Developed checks and balances for daily operations through a calendar/task matrix, allowing management to verify consistency and accountability quickly and easily for quality assurance.
Performs analysis and diagnosis of highly complex networking problems in the Data Center Environment & capturing in Visio diagram for the network architecture and changes.
Always actively involved in new projects discussion/establishing connectivity to new client’s sites

Designed and Installed enterprise WAN network, which is Redundant with automatic fail over capabilities to support growing data network. changes, monitoring, problem escalation/notification/resolution and all other aspects of Data Center support
Data Center Health check Reporting information's about possible alarms for all equipment from Data Center, detailed information's and Rack density (% of cabinet and racks usage)
Updating of all network design documentation for each project worked, ensuring accuracy, Provides updates of each implementation and cause/risk for success or failure.

experience.role: Planning & Implementation of Metro Ethernet Network across Karnataka
responsibilities: Designing MEN networks for network rollout & customers’ requirements & documenting the same. Providing feasibility for Broadband Business Solutions, Patch management such as IOS upgradation etc. as and when required.
Responsible for IP/MEN network rollout & customers’ requirements By Planning & Implementation of IP/MEN Telecommunications Network.
Responsible for smooth deployment across the network for retail and corporate customers,
Involved in IP Planning & Fiber planning of Access & Core MEN networks for Reliance Communications at Circle Level [Karnataka] & ensures the network availability as per the QMS.
Prepare/Review Network Planning and Nodal Design Documents. Connectivity planning for high value customers based on inputs/projection of capacity requirements given by business team.
Responsible for Installation, Integration, Configuration & Commissioning of IP Device’s into live Network across Karnataka.
Offering & getting it cleared for Acceptance Tests, hardware & software upgradations & end-to-end testing of links.

education.institution: Board of Technical Examination Government of Karnataka.
